title: FEATURE — disk cleanup: delete intermediate dirs from run-TIMESTAMP pipeline outputs
rationale: disk watchdog: workspace/scs001/ is 11GB. Investigating with du shows 6 run-TIMESTAMP dirs (1.3-1.9GB each). Each has: editing/ (~600MB), mixed-output/ (~640MB), voiceover-audio/ (~9MB), caption/ (publishable videos — KEEP). Deleting editing/mixed-output/voiceover-audio frees ~1.2GB/run = ~7.2GB total. caption/ must be preserved as these are the publishable captioned videos. Script: cleanup-pipeline-runs.ts — scan workspace/scs001/run-* dirs, delete editing/ + mixed-output/ + voiceover-audio/ subdirs, keep caption/. Log bytes freed. --dry-run flag.
success_criteria: dry-run identifies ~7GB to free across 6 run dirs
live run deletes editing/ mixed-output/ voiceover-audio/ subdirs
caption/ directories preserved in all run dirs

tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/cleanup-pipeline-runs.ts: scan workspace/scs001/run-* dirs, for each delete editing/, mixed-output/, voiceover-audio/ subdirs (keep caption/). Log bytes freed per run. --dry-run flag.
